risk_summary: The excerpt is generally quantitative and transparent, with detailed trend, balance-sheet, credit-quality, and interest-rate data. Risk is moderate: profitability declined, deposit funding costs increased, noninterest-bearing deposits fell, and unrealized securities losses remained material, although nonperforming assets and borrowings improved. Boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and adjusted-income exclusions modestly reduce clarity but do not dominate the disclosure.
